config.action_normalization: x0/y0/length use patch-width scaling; signed bend maps symmetrically to [0,1] around 0.5; force and angle use min-max mappings
config.notes: The paper does not publish numeric task action bounds, crop margin, raster width calibration, dropout probability, or weight-map multiplier. Action bounds and these values are local choices; force range follows the verified Stage-1 sampler, not the F/T sensor measurement range.

stage1_config.notes: Paper robot family, 18x21 inch canvas, 24 wells, short 50 mm brush and Fig. A1 mount structure. Unpublished assembly dimensions estimated locally. Axial spring brush and continuous height-feedback force servo are simulation approximations.

action_encoding_audit: Actions rebuilt from unchanged raw_actions after fixing signed bend normalization; observations and simulator transitions are unchanged.
